name: drama
title_zh: 短剧的钩子、节拍和结尾悬念，写之前先翻这本规矩
tagline_zh: 写短剧最怕前三秒没钩住、中段节奏塌、结尾不吊人。它把这三件事拆成可照抄的规矩：钩子在第几秒落、每集几个节拍。
tagline_en: Short drama lives or dies on the first three seconds, the mid-episode rhythm, and the final cliff. This hands.
desc_en: The genre rules for short drama — the hook, the beat pattern, and the cliff an episode ends on.
why_zh: 它不写剧本，只给规矩。钩子、节拍、悬念三样被拆成可核对的条目，Agent 照着搭骨架，不会写成慢热长剧。
why_en: It doesn't write the script, it supplies the rules. Hook, beat pattern and cliff are broken into checkable items, so the agent.
limit_zh: 只管短剧这一格：竖屏、单集一两分钟、强钩子强反转。写长剧、电影、慢热文艺向它给不了节奏建议；也不产出成稿台词。
limit_en: Vertical short drama only: 1-2 min episodes, hard hooks, hard reversals. No pacing help for features, long-form or slow-burn literary work, and it.
title_en: Short-drama genre rules: hook, beat pattern, cliffhanger
